in_arabic.name: Jidah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Jidah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. A woman named Jidah is one who travels or goes on a journey, a pilgrim. It is derived from the Arabic root 'J-D-H' which means movement, travel, or journey.
